## Real Data

- [FRED: Real Gross Domestic Product Per Capita](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/A939RX0Q048SBEA), the long-run per-capita growth trend
- [FRED: Nonfarm Business Sector Labor Productivity](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/OPHNFB), output per hour worked
